> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `release tag: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance release tag <name>
```

Run the release-tag gate and, on pass, create the tag name capturing the full transitive bill of materials.

The gate blocks on any error-severity violation. For a system composed of components, it also requires every pinned component to point to a tagged release.

Exit codes: 0 tag created, 1 gate blocked, 2 tool or usage error.
